name: Release v0.8.9
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: make desktop control optional and idle timeout configurable by @zengfanfan in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/458
* fix: resolve the PowerShell executable against the child's PATH (#411) by @NishilRathod in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/459
* fix(tools): parse FileSystem and MultiSelect boolean flags through as_bool by @Dev-next-gen in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/461
* fix: recover stale desktop input after missed release events by @zengfanfan in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/460
* chore(deps): bump the all-dependencies group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/462
* chore(deps): bump platformdirs from 4.12.4 to 4.13.0 in the all-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/463
* docs: align installation guidance with the current package by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/469
* Add desktop gate policies and deliberate mouse takeover by @zengfanfan in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/466
* fix(scrape): improve Fake-IP DNS diagnostics by @legendteddy in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/473
* chore(deps): bump posthog from 7.67.0 to 7.68.0 in the all-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/468
* Skip the server's own windows when collecting control handles (Snapshot 15 s -> 0.6 s) by @Saturcolor in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/476
* fix(scrape): honour the document charset when Content-Type declares none by @michealmachine in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/477
* Fix Japanese IME mode events latching desktop control by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/481
* chore(deps): bump the all-dependencies group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/480
* fix: release SendKeys keys after interrupted chords by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/485
* Shortcut: natural punctuation names; MultiSelect: validate points before pressing Ctrl (#483) by @junglin830 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/487
* Fix visible console window left open by windows-mcp install by @junglin830 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/486
* Exclude hidden directory contents from recursive listings by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/491
* Delete symbolic links and junctions without removing their targets by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/490
* fix(filesystem): reject overlapping copy and move paths by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/489
* Pass registry key paths literally so wildcard key names don't hit sibling keys by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/492
* Bound UI Automation calls with IUIAutomation2 timeouts and stop retrying timed-out windows (refs #383) by @WindriseAI in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/497
* chore(deps): bump the all-dependencies group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/484
* chore(deps): bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/499
* chore(deps): bump opentelemetry-api from 1.45.0 to 1.45.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/501
* chore(deps): bump certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.19 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/500
* Document the required application ID for toast notifications by @zwk110 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/503
* Decode schtasks and PowerShell output with the console code page by @mayuriphad in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/502
* Ignore mouse motion that does not move the cursor by @nalikip in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/508
* Report region-filtered UI tree scope in Snapshot responses by @zwk110 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/507
* Sample snapshot cursor position after desktop and tree collection by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/509
* chore(deps): bump the all-dependencies group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/510
* chore(deps): bump authlib from 1.8.0 to 1.9.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/512
* chore(deps): bump dnspython from 2.8.0 to 2.9.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/511
* fix(filesystem): allow case-only renames in move mode by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/513
* fix(filesystem): report symlinks and junctions in info mode by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/514
* fix(filesystem): strip the NT path prefix from info-mode link targets by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/517
* fix(filesystem): decode BOM-marked UTF-16 and UTF-8 files in read mode by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/516
* fix(filesystem): remove read-only files in recursive delete and overwrite by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/515
* fix(process): measure CPU usage over a short window and skip the Idle process by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/521
* fix(scrape): return non-HTML bodies as fetched instead of running markdownify by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/522
* fix(install): make start-server.cmd work from non-ASCII profile paths by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/523
* fix(config): escape strings in write_config so auth --with-tls saves a loadable config by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/524
* fix(powershell): escape typographic single quotes in ps_quote by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/525
* fix(registry): stop list mode hiding PS values, cutting arrays and wrapping lines by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/526
* fix(filesystem): stop write mode doubling the carriage return in CRLF content by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/537
* fix(filesystem): let read mode return line ranges from files over 10 MB by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/538
* fix(config): load config.toml files saved with a UTF-8 BOM by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/541
* fix(filesystem): stop move mode deleting a directory when a file is moved onto it by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/540
* fix(scrape): fetch the page off the event loop so Scrape stops freezing the server by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/539
* fix(filesystem): resolve ~ to the user's home folder instead of a '~' folder on the Desktop by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/543
* fix(filesystem): hide entries with the Windows hidden attribute in list mode by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/542
* fix(control): report why the controller is unavailable by @FaberVi in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/532
* fix(cli): stop auth printing 0.0.0.0 and unbracketed IPv6 addresses as the client URL by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/544
* feat(tree): optionally merge per-glyph Word nodes into line runs by @FaberVi in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/534
* docs(move): state that drag does not work on XAML shell surfaces by @FaberVi in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/536
* fix(control): keep the indicator heartbeat fresh while building layers by @FaberVi in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/535
* feat(snapshot): add save_path to write the screenshot to a PNG file by @FaberVi in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/533
* fix(desktop): list windows in z-order so Snapshot's Depth column is the stacking order by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/549
* fix(cli): honor WINDOWS_MCP_DEBUG again and let debug mode reach stderr by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/547
* feat(control): tag the cursor glow with "AI" and mark each AI click by @ShengLin1001 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/553
* fix(registry): write Binary and MultiString values as arrays by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/564
* fix(powershell): decode CLIXML error output from Windows PowerShell by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/563
* fix(desktop): walk the other windows in z-order when building the UI tree by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/550
* fix(snapshot): show the text selection the UI tree walk already records by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/551
* fix(tools): accept JSON-string arrays for Snapshot/Screenshot `display` and App `window_loc`/`window_size` by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/545
* fix(desktop): exclude hung processes before Snapshot window metadata queries by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/568
* fix(process): let kill mode match a process name given without .exe by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/546
* fix(registry): read a value whose name contains wildcard characters by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/570
* fix(scrape): say "Reached bottom" for a page that does not scroll by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/575
* fix(tools): parse Snapshot, Screenshot, Scrape and Process flags strictly by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/574
* fix(input): say what Scroll and Click did by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/573
* fix(registry): refuse an empty value name instead of deleting the key by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/571
* fix(powershell): keep inherited variables whose registry name has another case by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/572
* Report rejected cursor positioning as an input tool error by @minhoyooDEV in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/576
* fix(screenshot): wait for a fresh DXGI frame instead of returning a stale one by @cyppe in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/560
* fix(type): clear fields without Ctrl+A and report what the field reads back by @cyppe in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/558
* feat(control): ask before AI starts a new desktop control period by @ShengLin1001 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/552
* Report a click that a modal dialog swallowed by @Eapp1e in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/581
* fix(app): match the switch target from the window list without a UI tree walk by @1AbdullahButt in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/580
* perf(overlay): premultiply with Pillow channel ops and fade the flash with window opacity by @cyppe in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/562
* fix(screenshot): say windows were not listed instead of 'No windows found' by @cyppe in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/559
* fix(powershell): cap long output and distinguish timeouts by @tumbledseea in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/585
* fix(type): put the caret at the start or end of a multi-line field by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/591
* fix(registry): show a value's type and stored form in get mode by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/590
* fix(type): put the whole clipboard back after pasting long text by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/589
* fix(process): refuse a list limit below 1 by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/588
* fix(powershell): return when PowerShell exits, not at pipe EOF by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/587
* fix(input): reject Move, Scroll, drag and MultiSelect points outside the desktop by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/593
* fix(snapshot): clip UI elements to the current virtual screen, not the one at server start by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/592
* fix(desktop): keep Snapshot and Screenshot working when the virtual desktop query fails by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/594
* fix(snapshot): show which radio button, tab or list item is selected by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/601
* fix(filesystem): append to BOM-marked files in their own encoding by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/602
* fix(powershell): keep programs the command started when it times out by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/597
* feat(powershell): send progress notifications while a command runs by @Mystery01092000 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/605
* fix(process): list only processes whose name matches the filter by @jaeminbird in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/603
* fix(control): recover the overlay after a missed ack timeout by @MaxWang007 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/606
* fix(registry): list values with their type and stored form by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/599
* fix(screenshot): draw the requested reference grid on clean screenshots (use_annotation=False) by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/600
* fix(filesystem): do not walk into junctions in recursive list and search by @Plastic-time in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/598
* fix(app): list the windows again before App switch matches a name by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/596
* feat(control): keep AI control until the agent releases it or the user takes over by @ShengLin1001 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/595
* fix(uia): fail fast on abandoned worker calls, expose ui_busy in ControlStatus, and bound stalled leases by @Nani-2007-code in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/608
